gazette: Additional provision section with new § 1 (definition of leverage by reference to § 1, item 29 of the additional provisions of the collective investment schemes act), created by § 10 of the amending ordinance in ДВ бр. 61 от 2026
note: lex.bg lines 45-47: the additional-provision heading and its marker Нова - ДВ, бр. 61 от 2026 are followed directly by the final-provisions heading, with no § 1; Gazette line 323-324: § 10 creates that subdivision with new § 1 and gives its text; Gazette line 325: § 11 renumbers old § 1 as § 3, matching lex.bg line 49, so § 1 is the only provision missing
tails_note: lex.bg prints Допълнителна разпоредба marked Нова - ДВ бр. 61/2026 with no text, and § 3 marked предишен § 1, implying a new § 1 lex.bg lacks; Gazette material 2308 is the 2006 original (§ 1, § 2 under Заключителни разпоредби) and does not hold the 2026 amendment, so the texts given cannot settle it
